\section{Measurements}

The sample was held at \SI{298.15}{\kelvin} under \SI{1.2(3)}{\bar}, giving a
molar mass of \SI{18.015}{\gram\per\mole} and a flow of
\SI{2.5e-3}{\cubic\metre\per\second}. Ranges are written \SIrange{10}{20}{\celsius}
and bare numbers as \num{6.022e23}.
